description: 自宅の玄関前で、女性がスマートフォンの配達アプリを確認しながら、配達員から注文した食事を受け取っている場面。

stage1.passage: Recently, food delivery services have become popular because people can order meals from restaurants by using smartphone apps. These services are especially useful for busy people who want to enjoy food at home without cooking or going out.

q1.text: Why have food delivery services become popular?
modelAnswers: Because people can order meals from restaurants by using smartphone apps.
They are popular because they are useful for busy people who want to enjoy food at home.

questions.text: Have you ever used a food delivery service? What did you order?
modelAnswers: Yes, I have. I used a delivery app to order pizza for my family.
I sometimes order hamburgers or Japanese food when I am busy.
No, I have never used one, but I would like to try a food delivery service someday.

questions.text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of food delivery services?
modelAnswers: Food delivery services are convenient because people can order meals without leaving home, but delivery fees can be expensive.
They are useful for busy people, but sometimes the food takes a long time to arrive.
One advantage is that we can choose food from many restaurants. However, delivery can create more packaging waste.

sentences.ja: 女性がスマートフォンで注文内容を確認しています。

sentences.text: The woman probably ordered the meal through a delivery app.
sentences.grammar: 過去形・副詞probably
sentences.ja: 女性はおそらく配達アプリを通して食事を注文しました。

sentences.text: She may have ordered food because she was too busy to cook.

sentences.ja: 彼女は料理をするには忙しすぎたため、食事を注文したのかもしれません。

sentences.text: Food delivery services make it easy to get meals at home.
sentences.grammar: make it＋形容詞＋to不定詞
sentences.ja: フードデリバリーサービスによって、自宅で簡単に食事を受け取ることができます。

sentences.text: At the entrance to her apartment, a woman is receiving a food order from a delivery courier.
sentences.grammar: 現在進行形・場所を表す前置詞句
sentences.ja: アパートの玄関で、女性が配達員から注文した食事を受け取っています。

sentences.text: The courier is handing over the meal while the customer checks the order on her smartphone.
sentences.grammar: 現在進行形・whileを用いた同時進行
sentences.ja: 利用客がスマートフォンで注文内容を確認している間、配達員が食事を手渡しています。

sentences.text: A bicycle parked nearby suggests that the courier may have used it to make the delivery.
sentences.grammar: 過去分詞による後置修飾・suggest that節・助動詞may・現在完了形
sentences.ja: 近くに停められた自転車から、配達員がそれを使って配達した可能性がうかがえます。

sentences.text: The woman may have chosen a delivery service because she did not have enough time to prepare dinner herself.
sentences.grammar: 助動詞may＋現在完了形・because節・enough＋名詞＋to不定詞
sentences.ja: 女性は自分で夕食を準備する十分な時間がなかったため、配達サービスを選んだのかもしれません。

sentences.text: Mobile delivery platforms allow customers to order meals from restaurants without leaving their homes.
sentences.grammar: allow A to do・without＋動名詞
sentences.ja: モバイル配達プラットフォームによって、利用客は自宅を出ることなくレストランの食事を注文できます。

sentences.text: Although app-based delivery services are convenient, customers often have to pay additional delivery fees.
sentences.grammar: Althoughを用いた譲歩節・have to
sentences.ja: アプリ型の配達サービスは便利ですが、利用客は追加の配達料金を支払わなければならないことがよくあります。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how digital technology has changed the way people purchase and receive meals.
sentences.grammar: 間接疑問を含むhow節・現在完了形・関係詞節
sentences.ja: この場面は、デジタル技術が人々の食事の購入方法や受け取り方法をどのように変えたかを示しています。

sentences.text: If delivery services continue to expand, society may need to consider their impact on traffic and packaging waste.
sentences.grammar: Ifを用いた条件文・助動詞may・need to
sentences.ja: 配達サービスがさらに拡大すれば、社会は交通や包装ごみへの影響を考える必要が出てくるかもしれません。
